title: Neon Quota Rush

selected_categories.reasoning: The main interaction is repeatedly pressing a single large action button to generate progress and currency, making the game structurally closest to an active clicker loop.
Each action directly converts limited inputs into money, and the central tension is building enough currency to meet quotas and unlock stronger earning power.
The play pattern revolves around repeated money-generating taps with immediate score feedback, even though payouts are resolved through slot-style reel matching rather than raw passive clicking.
There is a small sense of progression through sequential shifts, rising quotas, and persistent run upgrades, but there is little actual narrative content.
The upgrade choices create some lightweight strategic planning around expected value, but the game is not idle and requires direct input for every payout event.

uncertainty_notes: The category universe does not include a direct slot machine or arcade gambling category, which would otherwise be the strongest mechanical fit.
Because of that gap, clicker and money-progression labels are the best available approximations rather than perfect matches.
The courier-scanner fiction affects theme and presentation, but the actual mechanics are a three-reel chance-based payout loop with upgrade-assisted progression.
